decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1/ The proposed single-storey side/rear extension, due to its size, appearance and position forward of the front building line of the dwellinghouse, would represent an overbearing development, detrimental to the residential amenity of the neighbouring properties, and would detract from the character of the original dwellinghouse and the streetscene, contrary to Adopted UDP policies ENV.1.1 and H.3.4 and Revised Deposit (January 2001) policies ENV-B.1.1 and H.6.4. and the Council's Residential Extension Guidelines (July 2002).

Condition : 2 - 2/ The proposals fail to provide satisfactory off-street parking arrangements which would result in conditions prejudicial to the free flow and safe movement of motorists and pedestrians in the area, contrary to Adopted UDP policy T.2.5 and UDP Revised Deposit January 2001 policy T.1.4.
description: ERECTION OF A SINGLE-STOREY REAR AND PART SIDE EXTENSION TO DWELLINGHOUSE
